ai.seo_question: What did the Imam advise to prevent clothes from being lost by the cleaners?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructed the companions to inscribe 'Barakah for us' (blessing from the Ahl al-Bayt) on their garments before sending them to the tailors, a practice rooted in the Shia belief that the spiritual presence of the Imams confers divine protection. Upon implementing this, the garments were preserved from loss, illustrating the tangible efficacy of invoking the Imams' blessings in daily affairs.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Fazl, from one of our companions who said,

‘We complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Our clothes were lost with the cleaners’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should be writing upon it, ‘Blessings be for us’. So we did that, and no clothes of ours were lost after that’.
en.sarwar: 17. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “We complained before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the loss of our clothes with the cleaners. He (the Imam) said, ‘Write on them, “Blessing for us.’” We did so and did not lose any cloth thereafter.”
